terminals.name: dev-stack
terminals.description: Full OpenGeni local stack: native PostgreSQL/NATS/Temporal/MinIO infra, DB migrations + role provisioning, the Hono API (http://127.0.0.1:8000), control + turn Temporal workers, artifact materializer/outbox, and the React web console (http://127.0.0.1:3000). Uses the native infra backend and the in-process 'local' sandbox (no Docker). Set the OPENGENI_OPENAI_API_KEY secret to run live agent turns.
